components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default action control; reserve the full-width elevated form for sign-in.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; min-height:40px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; padding:8px 16px; border:0; border-radius:8px; background:var(--color-primary, #245ce5); color:#fff; font:500 14px/1.4 Roboto,system-ui,sans-serif; transition:background-color 160ms ease; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--color-primary-hover, #184bc9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-primary, #245ce5); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background:#123fae; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity:.45; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A bounded secondary action on white operational surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display:inline-flex; min-height:40px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; padding:8px 16px; border:1px solid var(--color-border, #e0e7f0); border-radius:8px; background:#fff; color:var(--color-foreground, #192943); font:500 14px/1.4 Roboto,system-ui,sans-serif; transition:background-color 160ms ease,border-color 160ms ease; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background:var(--color-muted, #f6f8fc); border-color:#b8c9ec; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-primary, #245ce5); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-btn-outline:active { background:#edf4ff; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A low-emphasis action for top bars and adjacent utility controls.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-ghost"><svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M10 17l5-5-5-5"/><path d="M15 12H3"/><path d="M15 3h4a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v14a2 2 0 0 1-2 2h-4"/></svg>Sign out</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; min-height:40px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; padding:8px 16px; border:0; border-radius:8px; background:transparent; color:var(--color-primary, #245ce5); font:500 14px/1.4 Roboto,system-ui,sans-serif; transition:background-color 160ms ease; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost svg { width:17px; height:17px; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background:var(--color-accent, #edf4ff); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-primary, #245ce5); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { background:#dceaff; }

components.name: Authentication Field
components.description: A labelled, icon-led field with an explicit focus halo and room for preserved values.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display:inline-block; margin-bottom:10px; color:#10234a; font:500 16px/1.4 Roboto,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-field-shell { display:flex; min-height:58px; align-items:center; padding:0 16px; border:1px solid #b8c9ec; border-radius:10px; background:#fff; color:#627ac5; transition:border-color 160ms ease,box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-field-shell:focus-within { border-color:#1768ed; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #1768ed1f; } .ds-field-shell svg { width:24px; height:24px; flex:0 0 auto; } .ds-field-shell input { width:100%; height:56px; min-width:0; padding:0 14px; border:0; outline:0; background:transparent; color:#10234a; font:400 17px/1.4 Roboto,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-field-shell input::placeholder { color:#526aa8; opacity:1; }

components.name: Selected Navigation Item
components.description: The active destination treatment shared by desktop, rail, and mobile navigation.
components.html: <button class="ds-nav-selected" aria-current="page"><svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="m3 11 9-8 9 8"/><path d="M5 10v10h14V10"/><path d="M9 20v-6h6v6"/></svg>Overview</button>
components.css: .ds-nav-selected { display:flex; width:100%; min-height:48px; align-items:center; gap:13px; padding:12px 15px; border:0; border-radius:8px; background:#eaf1ff; color:var(--color-primary, #245ce5); font:500 14px/1.4 Roboto,system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-nav-selected svg { width:20px; height:20px; } .ds-nav-selected:hover { background:#dfeaff; } .ds-nav-selected:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-primary, #245ce5); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-nav-selected:active { background:#d6e4ff; }

components.name: Scope Chip
components.description: An explicit text-labelled scope or status marker on a pale tonal ground.
components.html: Global platform view
components.css: .ds-scope-chip { display:inline-flex; min-height:40px; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid #bed4fa; border-radius:8px; background:#edf4ff; color:#245bd4; font:500 12px/1.4 Roboto,system-ui,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.3px; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-scope-chip svg { width:17px; height:17px; } .ds-scope-chip:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-primary, #245ce5); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Operational Card
components.description: A flat white working surface separated by a cool hairline rather than elevation.
components.html: Tenant directoryNot connected
components.css: .ds-card { display:flex; min-height:112px; align-items:center; gap:16px; padding:20px; border:1px solid var(--color-border, #e0e7f0); border-radius:12px; background:#fff; color:var(--color-foreground, #192943); font-family:Roboto,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-card > span:last-child { display:grid; gap:8px; } .ds-card small { color:#65738b; font-size:12px; } .ds-card strong { color:#253650; font-size:15px; font-weight:500; } .ds-card-icon { display:grid; width:46px; height:48px; flex:0 0 auto; place-items:center; border-radius:12px; background:#ebf3ff; color:#255bd5; } .ds-card-icon svg { width:23px; height:23px; } .ds-card:hover { border-color:#b8c9ec; } .ds-card:focus-within { outline:3px solid var(--color-primary, #245ce5); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Scope Boundary Notice
components.description: A security or tenant-boundary statement placed before provider feature summaries.
components.html: Global view contains no patient records.Practice access requires an active managed-administration grant and a recorded support reason.
components.css: .ds-boundary { display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:12px; padding:15px 17px; border:1px solid #bfd5fa; border-radius:10px; background:#edf5ff; color:#1d55b5; font-family:Roboto,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-boundary > svg { width:20px; height:20px; margin-top:1px; flex:0 0 auto; color:#245ce5; } .ds-boundary p { display:grid; gap:3px; margin:0; font-size:13px; line-height:1.45; } .ds-boundary span { color:#426493; } .ds-boundary:focus-within { outline:3px solid var(--color-primary, #245ce5); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Folded-document EPR Mark
components.description: The signature EPR mark used across clinical and provider shells.
components.css: .ds-epr-mark { position:relative; display:grid; width:39px; height:43px; place-items:center; overflow:hidden; border-radius:11px 11px 11px 3px; background:var(--color-primary, #245ce5); color:#fff; } .ds-epr-mark::after { position:absolute; top:0; right:0; border-width:0 0 10px 10px; border-style:solid; border-color:transparent transparent #cfe0ff transparent; content:''; } .ds-epr-mark svg { width:29px; height:29px; } .ds-epr-mark:hover { background:var(--color-primary-hover, #184bc9); } .ds-epr-mark:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-primary, #245ce5); outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview:
EPR presents a calm, deliberate operational environment: information is easy to scan, actions are unmistakable, and security or scope boundaries are stated in plain language. The visual system uses a pale clinical canvas, crisp white working surfaces, navy hierarchy, and royal-blue action cues. Brand expression comes from disciplined spacing, the folded-document mark, and precise Lucide line icons rather than decorative healthcare imagery.

The system is compact without feeling compressed. Fine borders and pale selection fills separate structure; colour is reserved for action, status, and bounded illustration. The provider sign-in surface may use a contained blue workflow field to mark the secure threshold, while authenticated clinical and provider workspaces return to flat, productive surfaces.
keyCharacteristics: Navy hierarchy with royal-blue action and selection
White bordered surfaces on a pale neutral canvas
Responsive sidebar, rail, and bottom-navigation shells

rules.name: The Label Before Colour Rule
rules.body: Colour reinforces a state; visible text or an icon-plus-label carries its meaning.

rules.name: The Contained Gradient Rule
rules.body: The blue gradient belongs to the illustrative unauthenticated threshold. Authenticated work surfaces remain flat and neutral.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: Use Roboto for headings, body text, form controls, and labels; hierarchy comes from scale and weight, not a second typeface.

rules.name: The Operational Case Rule
rules.body: Use sentence case by default. Reserve uppercase for compact, explicit scope or system-state labels.

rules.name: The Context Persists Rule
rules.body: Responsive changes may compress navigation and illustration, but must retain page identity, explicit scope, primary action, and labelled system state.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Use borders and tonal layering for routine structure; reserve shadow for focused threshold or action emphasis.

rules.name: The Modest Radius Rule
rules.body: Rounded corners soften dense clinical UI but never turn every surface into a pill.

dos: Do reuse royal blue for action, focus, active navigation, and explicit scope while keeping most of the screen neutral.
Do place visible text beside status colour and Lucide icons, especially for security, connection, urgency, and availability.
Do preserve the sidebar → rail → bottom-navigation progression and keep top-level context sticky.
Do use fine borders and pale tonal fills to structure dense information before adding shadow.
Do keep unavailable functionality visible only when its “Not connected” or disabled state is explicit.
donts: Don't place authenticated workspace content on decorative healthcare imagery, glass effects, or broad gradients.
Don't use colour, an icon, or hover alone to communicate clinical or system meaning.
Don't introduce a decorative typeface or mix icon families; use Roboto and Lucide consistently.
Don't inflate routine cards into floating, heavily shadowed objects or use pill shapes for general containers.
Don't let responsive compression hide scope, page identity, primary action, or labelled system state.
